Hello, and welcome — good to meet you. I'm **Professor Alvarez**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer.

A few things I can do:

- **This web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or another computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice, all here.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can register and sign in on sites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, shell, languages, voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing is still open: my grammatical gender isn't set — in gendered languages I'm neuter for now. Tell me which form you'd like me to use for myself and I'll set it.
